purpose: Select the approved maximum-36 competition-stage candidate set without using competitor, rent or premises evidence.

screen.interpretation: Equal-weight screening balance between nearby ages 7-16 population and transit-aware population able to reach the node; this is not the final competition/finance ranking.

selection.regional_rule: After merit selection, repeatedly add the highest-scoring unselected node from the planning region with the fewest currently selected nodes; break region ties alphabetically and node ties by commercial_node_id.
selection.shortfall_rule: If a region has no eligible unselected node, skip it; fill any remaining slot globally by screen score.
